metadata.score_methodology: Hybrid: 36/65 companies scored with logistic regression (Form 4 + financials); remainder scored with rule-based attractiveness model only

A large strategic acquirer in health system software or pharmaceutical marketing — such as a Veeva Systems or an Epic-adjacent platform — would be the most natural buyer, seeking to embed Doximity's physician network of over 80% of U.S. doctors as a proprietary distribution channel for clinical tools, data products, or drug commercialization workflows.
